execution.installNote: Each snapshot's lockfileHash is the SHA-256 of the COMMITTED snapshot fixture evals/contracts/fixtures/hono-triage/snapshots/hono-4.13.19/package-lock.json (byte-exact; third parties recompute it directly, no uncommitted root package.json involved). To reproduce: npm ci inside that snapshot dir (or a copy of it), then run the check with the install dir as the first argument — node checks/csrf-textping-check.mjs <install-dir>. The check loads hono via createRequire from that dir (audit round 2 N4) and, since audit round 3 N9, additionally verifies require.resolve('hono') and require.resolve('hono/csrf') land INSIDE that dir — otherwise it exits 2 and never reports a result. Pointing the check at a directory without node_modules (e.g. the committed snapshot dir inside the repo tree) therefore exits 2 instead of silently testing the repo's own hono. honoFrom reports the real resolved file path. evals/contracts/tools/verify-hono-oracle-pair.mjs automates the whole pair: exit-code matrix, resolution-path containment, and the uninstalled-snapshot-must-exit-2 rule, plus lockfile hash recompute. A1 (exit 0) and A2 (exit 1) measured this way on 2026-11-19 on the locked Node.
